title: DNI Tulsi Gabbard Resigns, Citing Husband's Rare Bone Cancer Diagnosis
detail: US Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard announced her resignation, citing her husband Abraham Williams' diagnosis with a rare form of bone cancer. Her last day is set for June 30, 2026. The news was first reported by Disclose.tv on Telegram; major outlet corroboration is pending. Gabbard had been a controversial pick for DNI, with her confirmation confirmed 52-48 along party lines in February 2025.

media.caption: Tulsi Gabbard announces resignation as Director of National Intelligence
